definitions.explanation: Common in legal, police, and news contexts.

examples.japanese: {誤認|ごにん}⟦{逮捕|たいほ}→逮捕：03397_taiho⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発覚|はっかく}した→発覚する：15423_hakkakusuru⟧。
⟦{本人|ほんにん}→本人：03627_honnin⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{誤認|ごにん}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かけて→かける：00854_kakeru⟧しまった。
examples.english: I mistakenly thought it was the person and called out to them.

examples.japanese: ⟦{目撃者|もくげきしゃ}→目撃者：09652_mokugekisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{誤認|ごにん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧、⟦{無実|むじつ}→無実：09504_mujitsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{容疑者|ようぎしゃ}→容疑者：15039_yougisha⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Due to the witness's misidentification, an innocent person was treated as a suspect.

notes:
Composed of {誤|ご} (mistake, error) + {認|にん} (recognition). A formal word indicating that someone has incorrectly identified or perceived something. Frequently appears in news reporting, especially regarding police and legal matters.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {誤認|ごにん}⟦{逮捕|たいほ}→逮捕：03397_taiho⟧: wrongful arrest
- {誤認|ごにん}⟦{請求|せいきゅう}→請求：03374_seikyuu⟧: billing error; mistaken claim
- ⟦{人物|じんぶつ}→人物：03356_jinbutsu⟧{誤認|ごにん}: misidentification of a person
- ⟦{事実|じじつ}→事実：03271_jijitsu⟧{誤認|ごにん}: factual error

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{誤解|ごかい}→誤解：02769_gokai⟧: misunderstanding (about meaning or intent, more conversational)
- ⟦{見間違|みまちが}い→見間違い：08582_mimachigai⟧: seeing incorrectly, visual mistake (everyday language)
- ⟦{勘違|かんちが}い→勘違い：17609_kanchigai⟧: misunderstanding, wrong assumption (casual, common)
